evidence_summary: All 60 candidates (IDs 820-879) have raw_score, calibrated_score, final_outcome, and market-level close_time recovered, but lack fold_id and calibration/validation split metadata. Close time recovery does not reconstruct partition assignments. Applying isotonic calibration retrospectively without true out-of-fold/calibration splits risks in-sample leakage.

minimal_retrain_scope.description: Retrain candidates with recorded fold_id and partition definitions (train/calib/val splits) to enable valid isotonic calibration.
